messages.subject: zero_inflation regressors in INLA...
parts:
I'm wondering if there is a way to specify different regressors for the zero-inflation component of an INLA model than for the count component (as can be done in PSCL)?

Also, I see that there is a "zeroinflatednbinomial2" likelihood model listed for INLA, but I didn't see it described in the corresponding "zeroinflated.PDF".... 

many thanks,
c

hi,

type0 is possible not type1. for type0, the prob(y=0) does not depend
on the distribution for y|y>0, hence we can code this (or it can be
coded) with a different linear predictor for y=0 than for y>0. then you
need a similar trick as for

http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/r-inla.org/tutorials/spde/spde-tutorial.pd
f

chapter 6.


the reason for this, is the assumption that one observation y[i] only
depend on one component in the linear predictor, eta[i].
